name: AWS WAF - Cloud Security Monitoring and Analytics
description: The Sumo Logic AWS WAF (web application firewall) app provides a rich source of security findings allowing you to monitor the HTTP and HTTPS requests that are forwarded to CloudFront as well as control overall access to your content. Each dashboard in this application takes a different lens on AWS WAF data, from traffic patterns to threat intelligence, allowing you to truly identify the needles in the haystack that drives critical security concerns within your AWS infrastructure.
